metadata.title: That 1 kill where I wasn’t even looking but Valorant said ‘Yup, you got this’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did my crosshair just do the work for me?
Enemy must’ve been in chill mode.
Click if your best shots happen when your brain’s on pause!
Valorant’s logic: confusing but hilarious.

Tap if your aim ghosts you but kills still happen!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
